summary: Vodafone Group filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, disclosing a share sale by Shameel Joosub, CEO of Vodacom Group, a PDMR. He sold 745,000 ordinary shares at £1.195 per share, totaling £890,275, on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine insider transaction notification under the UK MAR, not a special-situation event. No strategic, structural, or corporate action is involved. Filing is equivalent to a routine Form 4 disclosure. What to watch: none; purely informational.
